problems.title: Pandas Data Manipulation
problems.description:
Given a CSV file with sales data (columns: date, product_id, quantity, price, region), write a Python function that:
1. Loads the data
2. Filters to sales from 'North' region in 2024
3. Groups by product_id and calculates total revenue (quantity * price)
4. Returns the top 5 products by revenue as a DataFrame

problems.title: Statistical Hypothesis Testing
problems.description:
You have two datasets representing click-through rates (CTR) for version A and version B of a website. Write a function that:
1. Performs a two-sample t-test to determine if there's a significant difference
2. Calculates the 95% confidence interval for the difference in means
3. Computes Cohen's d effect size
4. Returns a dictionary with: t_statistic, p_value, ci_lower, ci_upper, effect_size, is_significant (at alpha=0.05)

input_spec.array_a: float array of CTR values for version A
input_spec.array_b: float array of CTR values for version B

problems.title: Time Series Decomposition
problems.description:
Given monthly sales data spanning 3+ years, write a function that:
1. Performs seasonal decomposition (additive model)
2. Identifies the trend direction (increasing/decreasing/stable)
3. Calculates seasonal indices for each month
4. Detects any anomalies (points > 2 std from trend+seasonal)
5. Returns decomposition components and analysis summary

test_cases.description: Clear upward trend with winter peaks

problems.title: ML Pipeline with Cross-Validation
problems.description:
Build a complete ML pipeline for a classification task:
1. Load dataset with mixed feature types (numeric, categorical)
2. Implement preprocessing: imputation, scaling, one-hot encoding
3. Compare 3 models: LogisticRegression, RandomForest, GradientBoosting
4. Use 5-fold stratified cross-validation
5. Perform hyperparameter tuning with GridSearchCV
6. Return best model, CV scores, feature importances, and classification report

problems.title: Unsupervised Anomaly Detection
problems.description:
Implement an anomaly detection system for multi-dimensional sensor data:
1. Load sensor readings (10+ features, 10000+ rows)
2. Apply dimensionality reduction (PCA) retaining 95% variance
3. Implement Isolation Forest for anomaly detection
4. Implement Local Outlier Factor as comparison
5. Create ensemble scoring (average of normalized scores)
6. Return anomaly indices, scores, and visualization-ready data
